name: puppies_play
description: Puppies Play is a fun, bouncy script with connectors that give a playful flow. Perfect for baby shower invitations, nursery rhymes, and other items that require a fun, children's look. It comes with Latin Character sets including Western, Central, and Vietnamese language support. To contribute, see github.com/googlefonts/puppies-play .
